# Emmeline Koh – Solid Homes by Emmeline

> Emmeline Koh, CEA Reg. No. R045542G, PropNex Realty Pte. Ltd. (Agency Licence L3008022J). Your Trusted Singapore Property Advisor, in Singapore real estate since 2004.
> Call or WhatsApp 8275 4135 · solidhomesbyemmeline@gmail.com

Helping Singapore homeowners, investors and upgraders make smarter property decisions through strategy, data and experience. She advises homeowners, HDB upgraders and private-property buyers; her new-launch analyses focus on affordability, buyer suitability, exit competition and comparisons with resale alternatives.
